result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: partially cut-off restaurant cards and missing content labels that affect readability and usability.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off, showing only 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name, and the card itself extends beyond the viewport boundary
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll or card width so all restaurants in the carousel fit properly within the viewport, or implement proper truncation with ellipsis

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section (with the -20% discount pizza image) lacks a visible restaurant name and other key identifying information
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant name, delivery time, and other metadata are displayed consistently with the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it
